title: Transparency Maturity Model
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Organizational Analytics
description: Four-level maturity model for analytics transparency (Opaque, Notified, Informed, Participatory) shown as cards from dark to bright. A six-question yes or no self-assessment based on the chapter's transparency checklist marks the approximate level of an organization and lists the steps to reach the next level.

learningObjectives: Evaluate an organization's transparency maturity level and identify steps to improve
prerequisites: Process, purpose, result and limitation transparency

controls.label: Start Self-Assessment / Restart
controls.description: Begin or restart the six-question self-assessment

controls.label: Yes
controls.description: Answer yes to the current question

controls.label: No
controls.description: Answer no to the current question

controls.label: Level cards
controls.description: Hover over or click a level for an illustrative scenario and the step to move up

keyQuestions: Which level describes this analytics program?
Which checklist answers justify that level?
What is the next step up?
commonMisconceptions: Telling employees that data is collected is the same as being transparent
assessmentOpportunities: State and justify the maturity level of a described program
Recommend specific steps to reach the next level
